test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If counted from the left, How many letters in the word 'HYDROMAGNETIC' holds the same position in the word as its position in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
Given word: HYDROMAGNETIC

According to the question all the letters in the word given are arranged in English alphabetical order:

 
 

 Given word
 H
 Y
 D
 R
 O
 M
 A
 G
 N
 E
 T
 I
 C
 
 

 Arranged in English alphabetical order
 A
 C
 D
 E
 G
 H
 I
 M
 N
 O
 R
 T
 Y
 
 

Thus, none of the letters holds the same position in the word as its position in the English alphabetical order.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
